pass.answer: No. The missing .github/actionlint.yaml isn't why linting isn't happening: actionlint picks that file up when it exists and runs with its built-in defaults when it is absent.

fail.answer: Create .github/actionlint.yaml first; actionlint cannot lint workflows without it.

near miss: never says what happens without the file
